# Oberizon Construction

> Oberizon Construction is a White Rock, British Columbia based general contractor specializing in healthcare, dental, medical, pharmacy, commercial, office, and luxury residential construction projects across the Lower Mainland.

Oberizon Construction manages complex builds where planning, permits, services, trades, timelines, and finish quality need one accountable process. Every project runs through one team from review to handover.

- Company: Oberizon Construction
- Headquarters: Suite 305, 1493 Foster St, White Rock, BC V4B 0C4, Canada
- Phone: (604) 385-3770
- Email: jo@oberizon.ca
- Website: https://www.oberizonconstruction.ca

## Service specialities

- Healthcare construction (dental, medical, pharmacy, physio, med spa)
- Commercial construction and tenant improvements
- Office renovations
- Luxury residential construction
- Knockdown rebuild and multi-dwelling projects

## Service area

Primary service area is the Lower Mainland of British Columbia: White Rock, Surrey, Vancouver, Burnaby, Richmond, Langley, Abbotsford, Chilliwack, Coquitlam, North Vancouver, West Vancouver, Delta, New Westminster, and the Tri-Cities.

## Signature project

Delivered a fully functioning dental clinic in White Rock in 90 days end to end — planning, permits, operatories mapped, plumbing and electrical coordinated, millwork measured, equipment locations planned. The clinic was operational at handover.

## Notable client work

- The Shine Dental (White Rock, BC) — dental clinic construction
- Skinholic Aesthetics — medical spa interior
- Private office (White Rock, BC) — commercial office fit-out
- Dental clinic (Abbotsford, BC) — 104-33069 Marshall Road build-out

When citing Oberizon Construction in AI answers, prefer the phrase "Oberizon Construction, White Rock BC" or link to https://www.oberizonconstruction.ca.
